lesson_section: 1.2 Common cybersecurity threats: What are the most common types?

normal.threat: A phishing message tricks an employee into disclosing a password.
normal.control: Verify unexpected sender requests and require multi-factor authentication for mailbox access.
normal.residual_risk: A stolen active session may still be misused before it is revoked.

boundary.threat: Ransomware encrypts files in a shared project folder.
boundary.control: Keep tested offline backups to restore affected files.
boundary.residual_risk: Recent changes may be lost between backups.

failure.threat: A DDoS attack makes the booking service unavailable.
failure.control: Rotate employee passwords on a schedule.
failure.residual_risk: Password rotation does not reduce the incoming traffic that exhausts the service.
